objectives: Designed with the aim to transform the process of everyday media production and consumption into an active, critical process, this course will provide you with a multidisciplinary approach to questions around media, culture and power.
content: With a particular focus on the politics of representation and histories of anti-imperial resistance, we will explore topics such as gendered and racialized representation, globalization, leftist historiography of Cold War Division, cultural identity as well as formations of neo-colonial modernity in East Asia. The class format will combine lecture, guest speakers, small-group discussion, and oral report.
books: The Course Reader is available at Gaoguan
